label: Where
value: Ghalegay village, about 14 km south of Mingora
quote: located at a distance of 14 km south of Mingora

label: Roadside
value: Carved on the right side of the G.T. road, on the way to Mingora
quote: On the way to Mingora there is a statue of Buddha sculptured in a rock on the right side of G.T. road.

label: Cave
value: Some cave remnants beside the carving
quote: There are also some remnants in a cave beside this statue.

label: Size
value: Colossal Buddha on a boulder, 6.80 m x 3.20 m, 0.85 m deep
quote: A colossal Buddha image has been carved on a boulder measuring 6.80m x3.20 with a depth of 0.85m.

label: Condition
quote: Due to vagaries of time, the rock has been slightly eroded.

label: Protection
value: Protected under the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Antiquities Act, 2016
quote: Protected by The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Antiquities Act, 2016
